note: Achievements (src/achievements.js), from docs/achievements-design.md (Codex, updated 25 Nov 2026 for the party of three). Data only, for the browser prototype and the Godot game later. rule: count = a lifetime counter reaches min; set = every id in all has been seen; event = one moment in a journey that meets every condition. Only real journeys count, never practice battles or test mode. hidden = shown as ??? until earned; card = a story card for that hero (a collection row on the hero screen); icon = a slot for Codex's icon pack (docs/achievement-art-spec.md), empty until it exists.
